faq.q: What does the name Aalima mean?
faq.a: Aalima means Learned woman; female scholar (ʿālimah).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aalima?
What language does the name Aalima come from?
faq.a: Aalima is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aalima a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aalima is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aalima written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalima is written عالمة in Arabic and عالمہ in Urdu, and आलिमा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalima?
faq.a: The root of Aalima is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aalima?
faq.a: Feminine of Arabic ʿālim, from ʿalima, 'to know'.

faq.q: Does Aalima appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿālimah is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-l-m.
Aalima is the feminine of ʿālim, meaning 'learned woman, female scholar'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aalima?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalima total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aalima?
faq.a: Aalima appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Alima, Aalimah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalima?

Yes. Aalima is the feminine of the masculine Aalim; both come from the root ʿ-l-m.

faq.q: Where is the name Aalima used today?
faq.a: Aalima is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
